introduction.name: MUHAR
introduction.headline: I make existing software work better.
introduction.description: I look beyond the code to understand the real problem before reaching for tools. Most software does not need to be rewritten from scratch; it needs simpler architecture, targeted optimization, and room to grow. I work with existing systems to make them run reliably, scale cleanly, and stay useful to the people and business processes around them.
introduction.closing: Curious about how things work. Focused on making them work better.

thinking.headline: Curiosity comes first.
thinking.description: A problem is more interesting before anyone has solved it.

principles.title: Understand
principles.description: Get clear on the problem, the people in it, and how things work today before deciding what to build.

principles.title: Experiment
principles.description: I'd rather find out something is wrong early than build carefully in the wrong direction.

principles.title: Build
principles.description: Turn what I've learned into something people can use and I can keep changing.
